main.summary: Configures the HTTP transport used by a Catalog client.

property.name: HttpClient
property.summary: Optional HTTP client used for Catalog requests. When supplied, its BaseAddress and default Authorization header must be unset and must remain unset while this Catalog client is using it.

property.name: HttpClientOwned
property.summary: Indicates that CatalogClient takes responsibility for disposing the supplied HttpClient. Has no effect when HttpClient is not specified; internally created clients are always disposed by CatalogClient.
